operations.finding: conflicting final domestic decision flags
operations.rationale: The 25 January 2016 Supreme Administrative Court decision (doc:proceeding_rectification_2016_01_25) cannot be a final decision because the 13th Chamber later granted a rectification and quashed the earlier outcome on 30 June 2017 (doc:requestForRectificationFollowingAppeal / doc:proc_13th_chamber_annulment_30_jun_2017). The Constitutional Court decision of 23 May 2018 (doc:const_decision_23_may_2018_inadmissible) remains the single final domestic decision in the domestic chain.
operations.subject: doc:proceeding_rectification_2016_01_25
